 Job Title:

 Legal Consultant (Maritime Law) 
 Date of Posting: 
 29 September 2026 
 Application Deadline: 
 18 October 2026 
 Official Notification: 
 Call for Applications: Legal Consultant (Maritime Law) 
Applications are invited for the post of Legal Consultant (Maritime Law) on contractual basis in collaboration with Directorate General of Shipping, Ministry of Ports Shipping and Waterways, Govt. of India, Mumbai. 
 Requirements 
 1. Language Proficiency: Applicants must be fluent in English.
 2. Qualification & Experience : LL.M in Maritime Law or LL.M in Insurance Law, LL.M in Maritime Security Law or LL.M in International Law. Preferably with experience of 01 to 02 years
 3. Age : Candidate should be below 35 years as on 30-09-2026. 
 Remuneration: ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated) 
 Tenure: Initially for one year, extendable based on performance 
 Location: Directorate General of Shipping (HQ), Mumbai 
 How to Apply 
Applications are accepted only through the online application form available at the link provided below. Through the online application form, interested persons will be required to upload their resumé and statement of purpose, explaining their interest and the contribution that they see themselves making through this position. The statement of purpose must not exceed 750 words. Applications along with CV, documents and published writing or articles (if any) be submitted only through this link: 
 Click Here to Apply 
 Selection Process 
Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, based upon which, final selection will be made. 
 General Information 
The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum and the mere fact that a candidate possesses the same will not entitle him / her for being called for The University reserves the right to restrict the candidates to be called for online interview to a reasonable number on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed; or by any other condition that it may deem fit. Those who are possessing higher qualifications will be given preference in short-listing the candidates. The University may constitute a Screening Committee to scrutinize the applications and short-list the candidates. Call letters for test / interview will be sent only to the short-listed candidates and no correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed. 
It would be open to the University to consider the names of suitable persons who may not have applied, but recommended by experts in their respective fields. 
The University will have the right to relax any of the qualifications, experience 
Canvassing in any form on behalf of any candidate will disqualify such a

University will not be responsible for any technical problems in submission 
In case of any disputes / suits or legal proceedings against the University, the Jurisdiction shall be restricted to the Courts in Hyderabad, which is the Headquarters of the University.
